* The Application Engineer will also be involved in the support provided to the Regions (L1 &L2) in the support of root cause analysis (RCA) development, support to ticket resolution, support in the development of procedures, trainings to increase the Region capability and autonomy.

**Job Description**
**Services Solution Line, Central Team, Application Engineer,**
**Description**
The Application Engineer of FACTS & HVDC services activities will support the growth of the Regions by technically supporting the commercial team in the development of new opportunities. This role requires a broad knowledge of power electronics and electrical compensation equipment, strong sales acumen, the ability to work with engineering to develop new services and to work directly regions and global customers or other channels sales to identify, qualify and secure opportunities
  
  
The Application Engineer will also be involved in the support provided to the Regions (L1 &L2) in the support of root cause analysis (RCA) development, support to ticket resolution, support in the development of procedures, trainings to increase the Region capability and autonomy.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

+ Support the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process, including documentation and approval responsibilities.
+ Assist Regions Project Managers with regular follow-up calls to customers to resolve cases initiated through technical proposals or site interventions.

Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
  
  
**Required**

- Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
- Possess excellent interpersonal skills when interfacing with internal and external customers
- Ability to multi-task
- Self-starter, ability to work remotely and achieve results with little direct supervision, good understanding of Customer need is mandatory

- Proficient written, verbal, and phone skills in English
- Deep knowledge on FACTS/HVDC portfolio: Synchronous, Condensers, Fixed Series Capacitors, Static Var Compensators and STATCOM

**DESIRED**




+ Team player in an international environment, adaptability, autonomy, resourcefulness and focus on customer service and problem solving

+ Strong organizational skills
+ Engineering degree in Power electronics
+ Experience in the utility market, particularly with FACTS and HVDC systems and associated equipment, is a plus

title: Application Engineer for STATCOM
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux.
  
  
Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.).
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Apporte une expertise technique et développe des solutions techniques (configuration, estimation des performances, économie, etc.) dans le cadre du processus pré-ITO (demande d'achat) tout en assurant l'interface avec l'équipe commerciale. Possède une compréhension approfondie des marchés pertinents et de la valeur économique des clients, ce qui contribue à des stratégies d'adjudication gagnantes. Pour inclure « ITO » : Analyse technique du besoin client : définition et optimisation des produits ; du cadre (description) ; du programme ; du schéma industriel ; des coûts, compte tenu des contrats et politiques internes ainsi que des procédures. Calcul des performances et de l'efficacité des installations, des systèmes et des équipements. Documentation des spécifications techniques et des éléments de coût pour les phases ultérieures d'exécution du contrat. Cela inclut également la partie OTR (« de la commande jusqu'au versement ») où les ingénieurs s'emploient à personnaliser les produits et à les implémenter en fonction des besoins spécifiques des clients.
* Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis pour traiter des processus de fabrication plus complexes comportant une variété d'aspects techniques et/ou de cycles de production interdépendants. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. Transmet les attentes en matière de performances et peut gérer des problèmes sensibles.

**Qualifications De Base**


* Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
No

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302347
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Arihant Group, established in 1987, is a long-standing Indian solutions provider serving over 5,000 customers across the country. With a nationwide footprint and a diverse portfolio in electronics, electrical, automation, and process control products, the Group offers strong value to both customers and vendors. Arihant continually upgrades its infrastructure and resources and is recognized for turnkey project execution capabilities. Arihant Electricals, a key company in the Group, focuses on the supply and value-added distribution of electrical and electronic components across India and SAARC countries, making it a trusted partner for international and domestic brands.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Noida. The Salesperson will be responsible for identifying and approaching potential customers, managing existing accounts, and promoting Arihant Electricals’ range of electrical and electronic components. Daily activities include conducting sales visits and meetings, preparing and following up on quotations, negotiating terms, and closing orders in line with company targets. The role involves coordinating with internal teams for timely deliveries, maintaining accurate customer and sales records, and providing regular sales reports and market feedback. The Salesperson will also participate in product trainings and industry events to stay updated on offerings and market trends.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships.
* Good understanding of electrical and electronic components or related industrial products, or willingness to learn quickly.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in spoken and written English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Basic proficiency in MS Office and CRM or sales tracking tools for documentation, reporting, and follow-ups.
* Ability to work on-site in Noida, travel to customer locations as needed, and manage time and priorities independently.
* Previous experience in B2B sales, industrial distribution, or electrical/electronics sector is preferred.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Solutions Lead - BPO/BPS
description:

 This role requires a strategic and technically adept Solutions Lead to drive the design and delivery of winning solutions for RFPs, RFIs, and proposals, with a strong focus on the Banking \& Capital Markets (BCM) industry and adjacent financial services verticals. The ideal candidate will combine deep domain expertise in BCM processes, regulatory frameworks, and industry dynamics with proficiency in digital technologies, AI/ML, automation, cloud platforms, and data\-driven transformation to craft innovative, scalable, and client\-centric BPM solutions.

The individual will also contribute to building reusable solution assets, leveraging market intelligence for competitive positioning, and staying ahead of emerging technology and regulatory trends to strengthen EXL's solutioning capability and win rate in key BCM pursuits.

* **RFP \& Proposal Leadership:** 
 Drive end\-to\-end solutioning for BPM\-related RFPs, RFIs, and proposals across BCM and adjacent financial services verticals.

 Collaborate with Sales, Delivery, Product, and Technology teams to architect integrated solutions aligned with client goals and growth priorities.
* **Digital\-First BPM Solutioning:** 
 Convert complex business requirements into digital\-first BPM solutions leveraging automation, AI/ML, analytics, and cloud platforms.
* **Solution Architecture \& Value Engineering:** 
 Build solution blueprints, architecture frameworks, and tailored value propositions addressing BCM\-specific challenges — risk, compliance, payments, lending, and capital markets operations.
* **Client Engagement \& Storytelling:** 
 Present and defend solutions to internal and client stakeholders through orals, workshops, and demos with clarity and business impact.
* **Industry \& Regulatory Acumen:** 
 Track BCM industry trends, regulatory shifts, and emerging technologies; support cost modeling, risk assessment, and transition planning for proposed solutions.
* **Reusable Assets \& Accelerators:** 
 Build and refine reusable solution assets, delivery accelerators, and best\-practice playbooks to strengthen solutioning capability and reduce turnaround time.
* **Market Insights \& Competitive Intelligence:** 
 Leverage market intelligence to anticipate demand, shape Data \& AI offerings, and sharpen EXL's competitive positioning in BCM pursuits.
* **Tech Savviness \& Data \& AI Proficiency:** 
 Engage CIOs/CTOs with compelling, context\-driven articulation of EXL's Data \& AI capabilities within the client's technology landscape.



  




1. **SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE**



  




* **Domain \& Industry Expertise:** 
 Deep understanding of Banking \& Capital Markets processes, systems, and regulatory/compliance landscape, with exposure to adjacent industries (e.g., Retail \& CPG, financial services).
* **BPM \& Technology Proficiency:** 
 Strong working knowledge of BPM platforms (e.g., Appian), AI/ML, RPA, data analytics, cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks).
* **RFP \& Solutioning Experience:** 
 Proven track record in crafting responses for large, complex RFPs and client engagements, with experience working across global delivery and offshore models.
* **Communication \& Executive Presence:** 
 Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills with the ability to articulate complex Data \& AI concepts with clarity and impact across all levels — from ICs to C\-suite.
* **Analytical \& Creative Thinking:** 
 Strong analytical acumen combined with compelling storytelling skills to craft differentiated value propositions and drive creative, client\-specific solutions.
* **Customer\-First \& Commercial Acumen:** 
 Customer\-centric mindset with strong commercial judgment, long\-term relationship orientation, and the ability to translate client needs into high\-impact outcomes.
* **Ownership \& Execution Intensity:** 
 High accountability and execution drive in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments to bring order to complexity.
* **Collaboration \& Orchestration:** 
 Naturally collaborative with the ability to operate effectively across matrixed, global teams — delivering integrated, end\-to\-end solutions with clarity and decisiveness.
* **Curiosity \& Market Awareness:** 
 Passion for emerging technologies (Data, AI, Cloud, Digital) with a proactive approach to staying ahead of enterprise trends and translating them into client\-relevant solutions.



  




1. **Educational Qualifications \& Relevant years of Experience**



  





**Required** 



* **Bachelor’s degree** 
 in Business, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or a related discipline.



**Preferred (but not mandatory)** 



* **Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent)** 
 from a reputed institution, with a focus on Strategy, Marketing, Finance, or General Management.
* **10\+ years of experience** 
 in digital transformation, or solution architecture roles particularly in BCM industry and other related services industries.

title: Associate - PreSales
description:
**Job Profile:\-**




 This is a solutioning \& consulting\-focused role. We are looking for Pre\-Sales rockstars who deeply understand ORI’s conversational AI offerings and can map them to real business problems across industries (BFSI, Telecom, Retail, etc.).
 



 As a Pre\-Sales Consultant, you will work closely with Sales, Product, AI and Delivery teams to:
 


* understand customer journeys and pain points,
* design the right solution using ORI’s platforms,
* build compelling demos, proposals and PoCs that help win deals.



  





**Key Requirements:\-**



* Creating solution proposals, vision presentations and ideate solution architecture for the deployment of the conversational AI solutions.
* Understand customer technical requirements and work with partners and customers to align solutions.
* Participate in discovery calls and workshops with clients to understand business processes, current contact\-center setup, use cases, and KPIs
* Translate business problems into clear use cases, customer journeys, and high\-level bot flows (voice \& chat).
* Prepare and deliver product demos, PoC storyboards, and walkthroughs that showcase ORI’s capabilities in a simple, business\-friendly way.
* Work with internal teams (AI/ML, Product, DevOps, Delivery) to validate feasibility, dependencies, and effort for proposed solutions.
* Draft and structure solution documents, SoWs, effort estimates, and ROI outlines under guidance from senior pre\-sales / leadership.
* Support RFP/RFI responses by filling in solution, architecture, security, and functional sections using ORI’s internal knowledge base.
* Capture client requirements, assumptions, and risks clearly and ensure a smooth handover to Delivery after deal closure.
* Maintain and continuously improve internal collateral – decks, case studies, solution templates, domain\-specific playbooks.
* Stay updated on ORI’s roadmap, features, integrations, and success stories and reflect them in proposals and client conversations.
* Support Sales in pipeline reviews, bid/no\-bid decisions, and solution positioning, ensuring ORI is seen as a strategic partner and not just a tool/vendor.



  





**Our ideal candidate should have:\-**



* Total Experience: 2\-4 years in Pre\-Sales, Solution Consulting, Business Analysis, or Client\-Facing Tech/SaaS roles.
* Educational background in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, or related fields is preferred (but not mandatory if experience is strong).
* Strong conceptual understanding of at least one of the following:



 ○ Contact centers / customer support
 



 ○ SaaS / cloud solutions
 



 ○ APIs, integrations, and data flows
 


* Ability to grasp technical concepts (APIs, webhooks, cloud hosting, security basics) and explain them in simple business language.
* Excellent communication \& storytelling skills – strong in PowerPoint (solution decks, storytelling) and Excel (basic ROI modelling, effort estimates).
* Strong analytical thinking – can break vague problems into structured requirements and solution components.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced startup environment with evolving products, where documentation and processes are maturing.
* Exposure to AI / ML / NLP / GenAI / chatbots / voicebots
* Experience in BFSI, Telecom, E\-commerce, or BPO/contact centers
* Prior experience in demoing products to clients or working on RFPs/PoCs



  





**What you can expect from ORI:\-**



* Passion and happiness in the workplace with great people and an open culture, with amazing growth opportunities.
* An ecosystem where leadership fosters and builds an environment where everyone is free to take necessary actions to learn from real experiences.
* Flat team structures, with the ability to work closely with Board Members, Key Stakeholders, etc.
* Freedom to pursue your ideas and the opportunity to tinker with existing processes as well as create new processes that can then have a big impact upon the business.



  





***If you value ownership and are driven by building business in the charged and exciting environment of a high\-growth, technology\-driven startup, then this is the right job for you!***

title: Applications Engineering, Principal Engineer
description:
**We Are:**
 At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self\-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high\-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
   

  

**You Are:**
 You are an accomplished and forward\-thinking engineering professional with a deep passion for the intersection of artificial intelligence and semiconductor design. Your expertise spans RTL\-to\-GDSII flows, and you have hands\-on experience with industry\-leading EDA tools, especially those driving the next generation of AI and high\-performance compute silicon. You are highly analytical, able to dissect complex design challenges and architect robust, scalable solutions that address both immediate and future technology needs. You thrive in customer\-facing roles, translating requirements into actionable methodologies and championing innovation every step of the way.
   

  

 Your leadership skills are proven—whether guiding junior engineers, collaborating with global customers, or interfacing with R\&D to influence product direction. You communicate complex concepts with clarity, and your presentations inspire confidence and trust. Adaptable and resourceful, you excel at managing multiple priorities in dynamic, fast\-paced environments. You have a track record of technical excellence, a commitment to continuous learning, and a genuine enthusiasm for empowering others. If you are driven by solving tomorrow’s silicon challenges and have a curiosity to explore new AI\-driven design paradigms, you will find your next career milestone here at Synopsys.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
* Partnering with leading customers to develop and implement advanced AI\-driven RTL\-to\-GDS methodologies using Synopsys EDA tools, IPs, and libraries.
* Creating and optimizing design flows and solutions to meet aggressive PPA (performance, power, area) targets for high\-frequency cores, automotive, and high\-capacity AI/compute designs.
* Enabling and deploying flows/solutions leveraging Synopsys offerings such as Fusion Compiler, RTL Architect, and AI\-based Design Space Optimization engines, utilizing Tcl/Python scripting for automation.
* Collaborating cross\-functionally with customers, R\&D, and internal teams to drive innovative solution and feature development that anticipates and addresses real\-world design challenges.
* Leading and mentoring a team of junior application engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching, and project management support to ensure successful execution of deliverables.
* Delivering technical presentations, application notes, and best practices to both internal and external stakeholders, supporting knowledge\-sharing and customer enablement.


**The Impact You Will Have:**
* Accelerate customer adoption of next\-generation AI\-driven design methodologies, empowering them to achieve breakthrough silicon results.
* Shape Synopsys’ technology direction by providing valuable field insights and partnering with R\&D on new feature development.
* Reduce time\-to\-market and improve competitiveness for customers through innovative flow optimization and automation.
* Drive Synopsys’ leadership in AI\-powered EDA solutions, further differentiating our offerings in a competitive market.
* Elevate the technical capabilities of the application engineering team through mentorship and cross\-training.
* Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through proactive engagement, expert troubleshooting, and tailored technical support \& escalation management.


**What You’ll Need:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 9\+ years of relevant experience.
* Deep understanding of RTL\-to\-GDSII flows and hands\-on experience with backend P\&R tools (Fusion Compiler, ICC2, or similar).
* Expertise in physical synthesis, timing closure, clock tree synthesis (CTS), and routing at advanced technology nodes (like 2nm/3nm/5nm etc).
* Proficiency in Tcl and Python scripting for automating EDA workflows and optimizing design methodologies.
* Strong technical account management skills and a proven ability to lead and mentor teams in a high\-performance environment.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication, presentation, and customer interaction skills.


**Who You Are:**
* Collaborative and empathetic leader, skilled at building relationships and enabling the success of others.
* Analytical thinker with a problem\-solving mindset and a passion for continuous improvement.
* Adaptable and resilient in the face of evolving customer requirements and technology landscapes.
* Strong organizational skills, able to manage multiple projects and priorities with poise.
* Driven by curiosity and a desire to innovate at the forefront of AI and semiconductor design.


**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
 In individual contributor capacity you’ll join a dynamic and diverse Application Engineering team at Synopsys Noida, dedicated to driving customer success and innovation in AI\-enabled design automation. The team partners closely with global customers, R\&D, and product management to deliver state\-of\-the\-art solutions for the most advanced silicon on the planet. With a culture rooted in collaboration, technical excellence, and mentorship, you’ll have the opportunity to lead, learn, and contribute to the next wave of EDA innovation.
   

  

**Rewards and Benefits:**
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and consultative
 **AI Architect** 
 to help clients understand, shape, and activate the potential of AI in their business. This role owns the architecture of the AI solutions we propose — across pursuits, not just within one — and is accountable for the technical credibility of what we commit to.
   

  

 You will partner with sales, industry specialists, engineering, and client executives to turn priority AI use cases into architectures that are demonstrable in weeks and defensible at enterprise scale: secure, cost\-aware, evaluable, and buildable by the delivery teams that inherit them.
   

  

 It is deliberately a
 **hands\-on architect**

 AI/Gen AI/Gen AI

 Win and hand over

 Build the practice
   

  

* Create thought leadership and reusable IP; represent the firm externally at client forums, partner events, and in published material.
* Mentor AI Leads and engineering teams; grow the bench of people who can do this role.

**Must\-have Skills And Experience**
**Architecture and platform depth**
* Proven track record architecting and shipping production\-grade GenAI/agentic systems in enterprise environments — not only pilots.

**Agentic AI engineering (hands\-on)**

* Design and debugging of multi\-agent and long\-horizon workflows, including failure modes, recovery, and human\-in\-the\-loop control points.
* Strong experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, tokenization, and prompt engineering — including retrieval evaluation and knowledge\-freshness strategy.


**Engineering craft (hands\-on)**
* Hands\-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
* Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third\-party services, UI components, and APIs.
* Hands\-on Docker\-based deployment, CI/CD, and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control and review — mandatory.
* Working knowledge of modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).


**Model Provider And Hyperscaler GenAI Platform Know\-how**

 Good to have

title: US Proposal Specialist / Proposal Writer
description:
**US PROPOSAL SPECIALIST** 




  





 Acro Service Corporation, Bid and Proposal Team
 



  





**Experience: 3\+** 
 Years
 



**Shift:** 
**Night Shift (7:30 PM \-4:30 AM IST)** 




**Location:** 
 Noida Sector 68 (Onsite)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Acro Service Corporation (Acro) is seeking an experienced Proposal Specialist to join its Bid and Proposal team, supporting Acro's US staffing, MSP, VMS, and workforce solutions business from India. The Proposal Specialist is a hands\-on individual contributor and full member of the proposal team, responsible for managing assigned Complex and Express RFx opportunities from initial review through final submission. This is a fast paced, high ownership role covering the full response lifecycle, from initial solicitation assessment and Go No Go input through response planning, strategy sessions, content development, reviews, and final compliance and submission.
 



 Complex RFx are large, formal solicitations, typically from state and local governments and large commercial buyers, that require a full response plan, strategy sessions, and multiple contributors. Express bids are smaller, quick turn solicitations that one person can typically assess, assemble, and submit within a few days.
 



 The role calls for strong project management, judgment, and follow through: anticipating what is needed next, following up independently with contributors, and moving assigned responses forward without continuous direction, while working within Acro's proposal SOPs and escalating when a leadership decision is required. Solicitations carry strict compliance and submission requirements, and a single missed instruction can disqualify a bid, so close reading and attention to detail are essential.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



1. **Manage assigned Complex and Express RFx responses from beginning to end.** 
 Review the solicitation, build the compliance checklist and response plan, coordinate meetings and inputs, develop the response from approved Acro content tailored to the issuer's requirements, and drive it through final submission.
2. **Contribute to Go No Go and response strategy.** 
 Conduct the initial opportunity review, facilitate assigned strategy discussions, and recommend relevant Acro capabilities, experience, and proof points.
3. **Apply proposal and workforce solutions expertise.** 
 Build working knowledge of Acro's staffing, MSP, VMS, RPO, technical and consulting, and related services; use standard content only where it actually answers the requirement; and escalate pricing, contractual, legal, or significant solution decisions to the appropriate owner.
4. **Project manage assigned responses within the proposal SOP.** 
 Own timelines, dependencies, reviews, and approvals; anticipate bottlenecks; and apply the team's checklists, templates, and quality controls consistently.
5. **Manage proposal meetings and SME contributions.** 
 Facilitate kickoff, strategy, working, and review sessions, and obtain complete input from leadership, business development, operations, finance, legal, and subject matter experts, following up persistently until it is received.
6. **Develop, tailor, and integrate proposal content.** 
 Draft and edit clear, accurate, persuasive content aligned to the evaluation criteria, and integrate input from multiple contributors into one consistent response.
7. **Ensure compliance, quality, and submission readiness.** 
 Track every mandatory requirement, form, and submission instruction, and conduct thorough final compliance and quality reviews before submission.
8. **Track and interpret solicitation changes.** 
 Monitor amendments, addenda, and Q\&A, summarize their impact, and update the response accordingly.
9. **Maintain proposal content, references, and document control.** 
 Keep proposal content, templates, references, and past performance current, and maintain SharePoint organization, version control, and RFx Tracker status for assigned bids.
10. **Support continuous improvement and team priorities.** 
 Recommend practical process and content improvements, contribute to business development collateral, and collaborate on other team responses during peak periods.



  





**Requirements** 








* Demonstrated experience managing bids or proposals from solicitation review through content coordination, compliance, production, approvals, and final submission.
* Ability to manage both quick turn and complex responses with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and shifting deadlines.
* Experience facilitating proposal kickoff, strategy, and review meetings and converting decisions into actions and content.
* Strong critical thinking and judgment, with the ability to interpret requirements and evaluation criteria, identify gaps and risks, and recommend practical next steps.
* Excellent written English with strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, and the ability to adapt tone and level of detail to different buyers.
* Demonstrated attention to detail, including experience with compliance matrices and formal submission requirements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to obtain information from busy subject matter experts and drive accountability respectfully.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, tables, and templates, and working proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
* Ability to work U.S. Eastern business hours and communicate clearly and promptly with U.S. based colleagues.
* Familiarity with U.S. government procurement portals, SAM.gov, and cooperative contracts is strongly preferred.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Title: Subject Matter Expert** 




**Location \- Noida** 




  





**About Paytm Group:** 
 Paytm is India’s leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid \- Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.
 



**About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):** 
 PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm’s B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm’s PA PG business in the Indian merchants.
 



  





**About the role:** 
 We are looking for highly driven and customer\-focused professionals to join our Enterprise Payments team as a Subject Matter Expert (SME). The role requires working closely with Sales, Product, and Business teams to drive merchant acquisition, solution consulting, and adoption of Paytm’s payment products. The SME will play a critical role in enabling enterprise sales by providing deep domain expertise in card payments, payment workflows, and digital payment solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of the payments ecosystem, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex payment solutions into business value for enterprise merchants.
 



  





**Expectations / Requirements :** 




 ● Partner closely with enterprise sales teams to drive merchant acquisition and revenue growth by acting as a payments domain expert during client discussions and solution presentations.
 



 ● Engage with CXOs, payment heads, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand merchant requirements and recommend suitable payment solutions.
 



 ● Support sales teams in pitching Paytm’s payment suite including Card Payments, Tokenisation, International Card Payments, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway solutions, UPI, and value\-added payment products.
 



 ● Act as a trusted advisor for merchants by providing consultative solutioning aligned with their business models, payment flows, and customer experience goals.
 



 ● Work with Product and Technology teams to identify market requirements, product gaps, and opportunities for enhancing payment offerings.
 



 ● Contribute towards product ideation, competitive benchmarking, and feedback\-driven improvements to strengthen Paytm’s market positioning.
 



 ● Drive product adoption and merchant penetration by enabling successful onboarding, training, and solution implementation.
 



 ● Lead merchant\-facing discussions for new product launches, feature enhancements, and payment optimization initiatives.
 



 ● Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), use cases, and workflow recommendations to support product enhancements and digital\-first customer journeys.
 



 ● Coordinate with cross\-functional teams including Product, Compliance, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Technology to ensure seamless execution and faster resolution of merchant requirements.
 



 ● Track industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies within the payments and fintech ecosystem to strengthen sales strategy and customer engagement.
 



  





**Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed in this role :** 




 ● Minimum 5 years of experience in Payments, Fintech, Product Consulting, Solution Engineering, or Business Product Management with strong exposure to enterprise sales.
 



 ● Strong understanding of the card payments ecosystem including Card Processing, Tokenisation, Pre\-auth \& Capture, Payment Gateway flows, International Card Payments, and online/offline payment solutions.
 



 ● Ability to drive consultative and solution\-led sales conversations with enterprise merchants and senior stakeholders.
 



 ● Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to simplify complex payment concepts for business audiences.
 



 ● Experience working closely with cross\-functional teams and driving alignment between Sales, Product, and Technology teams.
 



 ● Proven ability to support GTM initiatives, product adoption strategies, and customer success programs.
 



 ● Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data, customer insights, and market intelligence to influence business decisions.
 



 ● A self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and dynamic fintech environment.
 



 ● Prior experience in fintech, payment gateways, banking, consulting, or enterprise solutioning roles will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Why join us:** 
 We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and how it will always be.
 



**Compensation:** 
 If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn\+ registered users, 21 mn\+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers \& merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

description:

 368981
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Technical Solutions Arch. Sr. Specialist \- PKI ( SCEPman, DigiCert) to join our team in NOIDA, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 The PKI and Encryption Specialist is responsible for the design, implementation, and daily management of the organization’s Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and cryptographic systems. You will ensure secure communications and data integrity by managing the full lifecycle of encryption keys and digital certificates.
   

  

 Core Responsibilities
   

  

* Infrastructure Management: Maintain and support enterprise\-level PKI solutions (e.g., Microsoft ADCS, PrimeKey EJBCA, or Entrust).
* Certificate Lifecycle: Oversight of requesting, issuing, renewing, and revoking X.509 digital certificates for users, servers, and IoT devices.
* Key Governance: Manage cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle—including generation, distribution, and secure storage—often using Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) like Thales or Entrust.
* Automation: Implement automated certificate enrollment and renewal processes using protocols like SCEP, EST, or REST APIs to prevent service outages caused by expired certificates.
* Policy \& Compliance: Develop and enforce Certificate Policy (CP) and Certification Practice Statements (CPS) to ensure alignment with industry standards like NIST or FIPS.
* Crypto\-Agility: Lead efforts to transition from legacy algorithms (e.g., SHA\-1\) to modern standards and prepare for post\-quantum cryptography.


**Technical Skills Required**
* Cryptographic Protocols: Deep understanding of TLS/SSL, SSH, PGP, and IPsec.
* Identity Management: Experience with Active Directory (AD), LDAP, and their integration with PKI for auto\-enrollment.
* Encryption Platforms: Hands\-on experience with tools like Gemalto KeySecure, Thales CipherTrust, or HashiCorp Vault.
* Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud\-based PKI services (e.g., AWS Certificate Manager, Azure Key Vault) and "PKI as a Service" (PKIaaS) models.

description:
**Senior NetSuite Implementation Consultant** 




**Location: Noida** 




  





**Bridgepoint Consulting, an Addison Group Company, is a leading management consulting firm that helps companies throughout their business lifecycle. We offer a broad range of finance, technology, and risk \& compliance services to support clients from startup to IPO readiness. As a leading full\-service NetSuite Alliance Partner, we provide a comprehensive set of solutions to help companies modernize technology and processes to surpass the competition in the digital age.**

* **Process Validation: Perform testing on system configuration and processes are aligned with client requirements.**
* **Data Management: Drive the transformation, migration and integration of client data to NetSuite to enable the usage and adoption of NetSuite for ongoing business activities at cutover.**
* **End User Testing \& Training: Develop comprehensive testing and training programs; lead client sessions to ensure high adoption rates.**
* **Quality Documentation: Produce high\-quality, professional project deliverables, including functional requirement documents and technical specifications.**
* **Client \& Risk Management: Act as the primary point of contact for project workstreams; proactively manage escalations, maintain RAID logs, and build long\-term client trust.**
* **Resource Management: Manage individual tasks and timelines to ensure optimal utilization and on\-time project delivery.**



  





**Strategic Consulting**

**Team Growth \& Development**

**Qualifications Required
 
 :**

* **Strong communication skills.**



  





**Preferred Experience
 
 :**

* **Core Competency: Understanding of Mobile app deployment, scheduling/dispatch logic, and real\-time parts consumption tracking.**

title: GeM & Tendering Expert
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and process\-driven GeM \& Tender Executive to manage our organization's end\-to\-end presence and business on the Government e\-Marketplace (GeM) portal and other government tender platforms (CPPP, e\-Procurement portals, state portals, etc.). The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience across the complete GeM lifecycle — from vendor onboarding and assessment to bidding, reverse auction, forward auction, order fulfilment, and payment realization.
   




**Key Responsibilities** 

  





***GeM Portal Management***




 •     Manage day\-to\-day operations on the GeM portal including seller/vendor profile management, catalogue creation, and product/service listing.
 



 •     Ensure timely completion of vendor assessment processes, including document submission, compliance checks, and empanelment requirements.
 



 •     Monitor and maintain OEM/vendor authorization, brand approval, and product category approvals on GeM.
 



 •     Keep vendor assessment score, seller rating, and compliance metrics updated and healthy.
 



  





***Bidding \& Tendering***




 •     Search, shortlist, and evaluate relevant Bids/RFPs (Direct Purchase, L1 Bid, Custom Bid) and tenders on GeM and other e\-procurement platforms.
 



 •     Prepare and submit techno\-commercial bids, ensuring accuracy of pricing, technical specifications, and compliance with tender terms.
 



 •     Track bid submission deadlines, EMD (Earnest Money Deposit) payment, and document submission timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate with internal teams (finance, technical, logistics) for tender document preparation, pricing strategy, and eligibility criteria fulfilment.
 



  





***Reverse Auction (RA)***




 •     Participate actively in Reverse Auction (RA) events, monitoring live bidding and applying competitive pricing strategies within approved cost limits.
 



 •     Analyze competitor pricing patterns and market rates to strategize bid decrements.
 



 •     Ensure timely and accurate participation in RA to maximize win rate while maintaining profitability.
 



  





***Forward Auction***




 •     Manage and participate in Forward Auction processes on GeM, ensuring compliance with auction rules and timelines.
 



 •     Coordinate pricing approvals internally before auction participation.
 



 •     Track auction outcomes and maintain records for management review.
 



  





***Order \& Contract Management***




 •     Process Purchase Orders (PO)/Contracts received via GeM — verify terms, acknowledge orders, and coordinate execution timelines.
 



 •     Track order fulfilment status: dispatch, delivery, installation (if applicable), and consignee acceptance.
 



 •     Manage CRAC (Consignee Receipt\-cum\-Acceptance Certificate) generation and follow\-up.
 



 •     Handle order cancellations, replacements, and returns as per GeM guidelines.
 



  





***Payments \& Compliance***




 •     Track and follow up on payment realization through GeM's integrated payment system (PFMS/bill processing).
 



 •     Ensure GST invoicing, e\-way bills, and other statutory compliance for each transaction.
 



 •     Maintain documentation for performance bank guarantees (PBG), EMD refunds, and other financial instruments as required.
 



  





***Reporting \& Coordination***




 •     Maintain MIS/trackers for bids submitted, RA/FA participation, orders won, and payment status.
 



 •     Liaise with government buyers, procurement officers, and internal stakeholders to resolve queries or disputes.
 



 •     Stay updated on GeM policy changes, GFR (General Financial Rules), and CVC guidelines relevant to public procurement.
   




**Required Skills \& Competencies** 

 •     Strong working knowledge of the GeM portal — bidding, RA, FA, catalogue management, and vendor assessment modules.
 



 •     Familiarity with public procurement processes, GFR, and government tendering norms.
 



 •     Good understanding of pricing strategy and competitive bidding techniques.
 



 •     Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for tracking and reporting.
 



 •     Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
 



 •     Good communication and coordination skills for liaising with government departments and internal teams.
 



 •     Basic understanding of GST, e\-invoicing, and financial documentation related to tenders.
   




**Qualifications** 

 •     Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or related field (MBA preferred but not mandatory).
 



 •     2–5 years of relevant experience in GeM operations, government tendering, or public sector sales.
 



 •     Prior experience working with GeM Sahayak/Seller Panel is a strong plus.
